answer: Make the jury unpredictable and independent: a randomness beacon selects each answer's graders by a wander across the identity graph, and the draw never lets an author's own cluster judge their work. A sybil operator flooding the network with fake accounts still can't steer which graders land on their jetty of pending answers — selection routes around kin. Genuine reasoning stays as scarce as hand-picked saffron; forging a thousand identities buys zero control over the verdict, so the attack spends real resources for nothing.
